scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm install && cd ../app && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: cd app && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 npx expo start --web --port 8080
scripts.web: cd app && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 npx expo start --web --port 8080
scripts.build: cd app && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r app/dist dist
